content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To firm your breasts, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Research specific pectoral muscle anatomy (30 minutes)
Step 2. Purchase a high-impact, properly fitted sports bra (1 hour)
Step 3. Watch a video on proper push-up form (10 minutes)
Step 4. Buy a set of adjustable dumbbells (45 minutes)
Step 5. Schedule a consultation with a fitness trainer (1 day)
Step 6. Design a 12-week progressive resistance program (2 hours)
Step 7. Take baseline measurements and "before" photos (20 minutes)
Step 8. Conduct a final progress assessment (30 minutes)
Step 9. Increase daily protein intake to support muscle growth (1 month)
Step 10. Clear a dedicated workout space in the home (30 minutes)
Step 11. Download a fitness tracking application (5 minutes)
Step 12. Set up the weight bench and dumbbells (30 minutes)
Step 13. Research skin elasticity supplements like collagen (1 hour)
Step 14. Start a daily moisturizing routine with firming cream (5 minutes)
Step 15. Join an online fitness community for accountability (15 minutes)
Step 16. Consult with a primary care physician about exercise (1 week)
Step 17. Perform the first set of chest presses (15 minutes)
Step 18. Complete the first full month of the workout plan (4 weeks)
Step 19. Adjust the sports bra straps for maximum support (2 minutes)
Step 20. Perform a warm-up routine of arm circles and stretches (10 minutes)
Step 21. Research the effects of cold showers on skin blood flow (20 minutes)
Step 22. Buy a high-quality firming body oil (15 minutes)
Step 23. Maintain the routine for the final month (4 weeks)
Step 24. Perform a set of pectoral flys (15 minutes)
Step 25. Learn how to perform a "plank to push-up" transition (10 minutes)
Step 26. Log the first week of weight lifting data (10 minutes)
Step 27. Purchase a yoga mat for floor exercises (20 minutes)
Step 28. Review and adjust caloric intake based on energy levels (2 days)
Step 29. Practice maintaining upright posture during the day (1 week)
Step 30. Organize a weekly workout schedule (20 minutes)
Step 31. Apply cold water rinses at the end of every shower (2 minutes)
Step 32. Perform "wall push-ups" to build initial strength (15 minutes)
Step 33. Perform three sets of standard push-ups (20 minutes)
Step 34. Incorporate incline bench presses into the routine (30 minutes)
Step 35. Read a book on strength training principles (3 days)
Step 36. Perform a set of "cobra" stretches for chest opening (5 minutes)
Step 37. Add dumbbell pullovers to the routine (15 minutes)
Step 38. Set a recurring alarm for workout times (5 minutes)
Step 39. Complete the second month of the workout plan (4 weeks)
Step 40. Evaluate muscle tone improvements in the mirror (5 minutes)
Step 41. Calculate the ideal macro-nutrient ratio for toning (1 hour)
Step 42. Perform "kneeling push-ups" to bridge difficulty (15 minutes)
Step 43. Increase the weight resistance on the dumbbells (5 minutes)
Step 44. Watch a tutorial on advanced chest isolation (15 minutes)
Step 45. Wash the sports bra according to care instructions (1 hour)
Step 46. Perform a set of "diamond" push-ups (10 minutes)
Step 47. Perform a "test" workout to find starting weights (1 hour)
Step 48. Take mid-point progress photos (15 minutes)
Step 49. Drink a protein shake immediately after training (10 minutes)
Step 50. Order a new set of resistance bands (15 minutes)
Step 51. Research the benefits of massage for tissue health (30 minutes)
Step 52. Purchase a foam roller for recovery (20 minutes)
Step 53. Sanitize the workout equipment (10 minutes)
Step 54. Post a progress update to the fitness community (10 minutes)
Step 55. Set new fitness goals for the upcoming quarter (1 hour)
Step 56. Transition to a maintenance workout phase (2 weeks)
Step 57. Perform a set of "medicine ball" chest tosses (15 minutes)
Step 58. Attend a group "upper body" fitness class (1 hour)
Step 59. Increase water consumption to 3 liters per day (1 week)
Step 60. Apply the firming oil after a nightly bath (10 minutes)
